title: K-12 Cybersecurity Act of 2021
official_summary:
K-12 Cybersecurity Act of 2021

This bill requires the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) to study the cybersecurity risks facing elementary and secondary schools and develop recommendations that include cybersecurity guidelines designed to assist schools in facing those risks. The use of such recommendations shall be voluntary.

The study must evaluate the challenges that schools face in securing (1) information systems owned, leased, or relied upon by those schools; and (2) sensitive student and employee records.

Further, the bill requires CISA to (1) develop an online training toolkit designed for school officials; and (2) make available on the Department of Homeland Security website the study's findings, the cybersecurity guidelines, and the toolkit.

summary.headline: A 2021 federal law directs the nation's cybersecurity agency to study school cyber risks and offer voluntary guidance and a training toolkit for schools.
summary.what_it_does: The law requires the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) to study the cybersecurity risks facing elementary and secondary schools. The study must look at how hard it is for schools to protect their computer systems and the sensitive student and employee records they hold. CISA must then turn the findings into recommendations and guidelines to help schools, and the use of those guidelines is voluntary. CISA must also build an online training toolkit for school officials and post the study, guidelines, and toolkit on the Department of Homeland Security website.

who_it_affects.group: Public and private elementary and secondary schools
who_it_affects.how: They can use the voluntary cybersecurity guidelines and the online training toolkit to help protect their computer systems and student and employee records.

who_it_affects.group: School officials and staff who handle technology
who_it_affects.how: They gain access to a free online training toolkit designed for their role.
Their personal records may be better protected if schools choose to follow the recommended guidelines.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Upon enactment on October 8, 2021, with CISA's study, guidelines, and toolkit to be produced and posted afterward; the law does not list a specific completion deadline in the summary provided.
